title: New England Retail Bank
bottom_line: Analysis revealed that reaching the $50 million goal in one year would require adding 250,000 investment product customers (a 260% increase from the current 70,000), which was deemed unrealistic. The recommendation was to pursue cross-selling as a longer-term strategy while further investigating why the bank's competitive position in investments is only medium despite strong market growth (7%) and attractive ROE (14%).
